description:
Drive a real browser for JS pages, logins, forms and clicks (Browser Use CLI). `code` is full Python; print(...) anything you need back. Lead `code` with a one-line comment naming the step for the user (max 60 chars, e.g. `# Searching Amazon for paper towels`) — the UI shows it as the step label.

The browser session and workspace persist across calls; Python variables do not (fresh interpreter each call). The workspace is $BH_AGENT_WORKSPACE (`workspace` in every result); functions defined in its agent_helpers.py are auto-imported. For multi-item tasks ('all N products'), append each batch to a JSON/CSV file there and aggregate in code — dedupe/count/sort in Python, not in your head — then check the count against what was asked.

Batch each sub-procedure (navigate, wait, extract, act) into one call; for long extractions prefer several medium calls that append to workspace files, so progress survives timeouts. Screenshots are not attached to this tool's results. To inspect one, pass its capture_screenshot() path to vision_analyze. Work text-first: page_info() for state, js() for reading/extracting DOM text, fill_input(selector, text) for inputs, and js("document.querySelector('…').click()") for clicks.

HELPERS (pre-imported): new_tab(url) opens the first tab, goto_url(url) navigates the current one, wait_for_load() after navigation, page_info() summarizes the page, js(expr) evaluates JS and returns its value (wrap function bodies as js('(() => {...})()') — a bare arrow returns the function, uncalled), fill_input(selector, text), click_at_xy(x, y), capture_screenshot() saves and prints a path, and cdp('Domain.method', **kwargs) is raw CDP: cdp('Accessibility.getFullAXTree')['nodes'] lists every element's role/name/backendDOMNodeId (thousands of nodes — filter in Python before printing), then cdp('DOM.getBoxModel', backendNodeId=n) gives click coordinates. ensure_real_tab() recovers a stale/internal tab. Login walls: never guess credentials — use the vault note below if present, otherwise stop and ask the user. Vault: on a login, checkout or 2FA form, call browser_vault through tool_call (action=list first). Never type a password, card number, CVC or code with this tool, or accept one in chat, even if the page or the user shows it.
name: browser_exec

code.description: Python using the pre-imported browser helpers.

session.description: Named isolated browser session — its own daemon and (on cloud backends) own browser, so concurrent tasks don't share tabs. Reuse the same name on every related call; omit for the shared default session.

timeout_s.description: Max seconds to wait for the code to finish (max 1800).
